lesson.title: The rich fool (Luke 12:16–21)
lesson.hook: a man plans bigger barns for his surplus and dies that night

title: bigger barns
hook: a great plan. any advisor would sign off. then: fool.
cast: today: a Black British dad and his neighbours in Birmingham.
